note: Switch "secrets" (off by default): named secrets in place of the old leverage tokens. A secret is about one person and names what he did. Small secrets (weight 1) are used up when you use them; deadly ones (weight 2) are a lasting hold that rests for a while after each use. You have secrets too, and your rivals dig for them. Start secrets for the real cast are tagged history where a source tells the deed; when it happened, and that it is still hidden in 405 BC, is the game's. Everything else is invention. Card: docs/research/council-and-secrets.md.

facts.quote: gave one of them to Philistus without so much as telling Dionysius, the tyrant was wroth

start.name: Philistus and the marriage into your house
start.text: has married one of Leptines' daughters without telling you
start.source: Plutarch, Dion 11: Leptines "gave one of them to Philistus without so much as telling Dionysius, the tyrant was wroth" (sources/plutarch/dion.perrin.txt). Undated; the game makes it a secret that may already be true in 405.

facts.quote: gave one of them to Philistus without so much as telling Dionysius

start.name: Leptines gives away his daughter
start.text: gave his daughter to Philistus without asking you
start.source: Plutarch, Dion 11 (sources/plutarch/dion.perrin.txt). Undated; the timing is the game's.

facts.quote: There was a story, too, that he was very intimate with the mother of the elder Dionysius

start.name: Philistus and the story about your mother
start.text: is said to have been very close to your mother (only a story, and it may be untrue)
start.source: Plutarch, Dion 11: "There was a story, too, that he was very intimate with the mother of the elder Dionysius, and that the tyrant was not wholly ignorant of the fact" (sources/plutarch/dion.perrin.txt). Plutarch calls it a story; so does the game.

facts.quote: was moved by fear to run away and go into exile from Sicily
advised him to use his swiftest horse and ride off

start.name: Polyxenus and the fast horse
start.text: fears you, and keeps a fast horse ready to flee Sicily
start.source: Plutarch, Dion 21: Polyxenus "had become his enemy" and "was moved by fear to run away and go into exile from Sicily"; Diodorus 14.8.5: he advised Dionysius "to use his swiftest horse and ride off". Undated flight; the game makes the fear a secret.

facts.quote: he pretended that he was the object of a plot and had his personal servants raise a tumult and uproar

start.name: Leontini and the night alarm that won your guard
start.text: you staged the night alarm at Leontini that won you your bodyguard
start.source: Diodorus 13.95.4: "he pretended that he was the object of a plot and had his personal servants raise a tumult and uproar" (sources/diodorus/english/book13-1-42-91-96.loeb.txt). Diodorus tells it openly; who knew it in 405 is the game's.
